text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, let's go to the park! I wanna 
ride that duck boat thing!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Yahoo-!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that was fun! How was it, Trainer? 
Feel like you became the wind?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
What's with you, looking so pathetic. Act 
like that, and people'll walk all over—

text_block_list.name: Undercut Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Oh my? If it isn't Pokke-san. The former 
leader of 『L/Roars』."

text_block_list.name: Undercut Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Hanging out with normies, having the time 
of your life, huh. Right when L/Roars is 
about to go under!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: L/Roars Leader
text_block_list.text:
—Pokke-san, I'm so sorry!! Hey, you 
bastards, the hell do you think you're 
doing messing with Pokke-san?!

The L/Roars leader and her crew rushed in. 
A heated argument broke out between the 
troublemaking Umamusume and L/Roars.
choice_data_list:
If it's L/Roars, then the ones picking a 
fight are...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Team "Giant K"— It's a team that broke 
away from L/Roars.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
These two teams have been clashing 
constantly as of late. Apparently, Giant K 
is scheming to absorb L/Roars into their 
ranks.
choice_data_list: No Reason!? Tch, you know a lot…

No Reason!? Tch, you're pretty 
knowledgeable…

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Heh... 'Know thy enemy and know thyself, 
and you will not be imperiled in a hundred 
battles'― I learned of it while studying 
Pokke-dono.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: —A battle is coming soon.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... It would be dull if L/Roars stayed 
on the back foot and made this a one-sided 
match. Allow me to grant you a strategy.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
It is wise to plant spies within enemy 
ranks.
choice_data_list: A spy... You want me to create a spy?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Always fight the battle with the enemy in 
the palm of your hand," as the saying 
goes. Control the information. Do that, 
and even a total turnaround is possible, 
you know?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
That Umamusume with the undercut hairstyle 
would be perfect. She barks at Pokke-dono 
constantly... She must have some kind of 
fixation on her.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
If you poke around that weak spot, they'll 
turn coat easily enough!

I shivered at No Reason's keen insight. 
...Still, gathering info in advance to 
avoid trouble might actually be a good 
approach.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hm, looks like the current leader settled 
the matter. Well then, I shall take my 
leave as well.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Hm? No Reason? What did she want?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Anyway, no spying. I hate that 
kinda stuff. ...All that drama's a pain, 
so let's just talk directly.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...So, I'm all ears! You got something to 
tell me, don'tcha?

text_block_list.name: Undercut Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? You looking down on me!? Quit acting 
cocky like you're still the head honcho!

text_block_list.name: Undercut Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"You can only run like a softie anyway, 
the way you are right now!"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's go one-on-one!

text_block_list.name: Undercut Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Find out for yourself whether it's 
naive—with your own legs.

Jungle Pocket is set to race against an 
Umamusume with an undercut. What words of 
encouragement should I send her off 
with...?
choice_data_list:
Just be free and be your usual Pocket 
self!
I'll shut them up with sheer strength.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: All right, I'm gonna do things my way!
And—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Hahahaha! Here I goooo! RRRAAAAGGGHHH!!

There is nothing holding Jungle Pocket 
back. She dashed across the turf with 
absolute freedom.

text_block_list.name: Undercut Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... *sniff*... W-Waaaaah! 
...Th-that's the Pocket-san from back 
then!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Hey, what happened!?

text_block_list.name: Undercut Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
*sob* I looked up to you, Pokke-san... I 
loved your free-spirited running... That's 
why I couldn't forgive you for going to 
the Twinkle Series...

text_block_list.name: Undercut Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
But... it hasn't changed at all! Even now, 
your running is as utterly boundless and 
free as ever...!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
You were worried about something like 
that? You really are an idiot.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: No matter where I run, I'm Jungle Pocket.

text_block_list.name: Undercut Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Yes!! I'll follow you for the rest 
of my life, Pokke-san!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Haha, look who's talking big now. —Leave 
it to me!
And—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ORA ORA ORAAAAAAAH!

Kicking up dirt, scattering turf, Jungle 
Pocket rampages across the track. Beneath 
her wild strides, everything submitted to 
her.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, put some more muscle into it. 
You're falling way behind.

text_block_list.name: Undercut Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Aah, ah... So this is Jungle 
Pocket's running...

text_block_list.name: Undercut Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
It was so... so overwhelmingly dominant! 
Look at me! I still can't stop shaking!

text_block_list.name: Undercut Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Pokke-san really is amazing...! I had no 
idea whatsoever!!

text_block_list.name: Undercut Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Pokke-san, I've completely fallen for you! 
Please let me follow you for the rest of 
my life! Honestly, I'd even follow you to 
Tracen Academy!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? —Wait, calm down! What's with you, 
why are you being so extreme!
choice_data_list:
Looks like I went a little too hard on 
them...

Looks like I went a little too hard on 
them...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Dammit! What is with all this~?!
